SECURITY_DESCRIPTION: How Plervo tests releases, distributes packages and handles security reports.
SECURITY_HTML:
Suite and app updates

On Mac and Linux, Suite 0.1.0-alpha.8 shows all detected installed apps and checks for newer versions automatically. A Suite update notice opens the correct official installer; install it and reopen Suite. Existing alpha.5 users need one manual upgrade to gain this behavior. Settings also offers manual checks.

Plervo Suite 1.0.0.0 is also available in Microsoft Store. Its Windows catalog currently offers PDF; installation and updates use the Store.

Dependency and notice review

Alpha.8 updates affected ctutils, rustls-webpki and WebPKI root dependencies and adds reviewed third-party notices to the twelve additional apps. The existing, narrowly scoped RSA advisory exceptions in PDF, Video and Develop remain documented; RSA itself is not patched. See the specific corrections, applicability and limitations.

October 2026 PHP security notice

The reviewed Plervo website is static HTML, CSS and JavaScript on Cloudflare Pages, and the desktop apps use Rust. No PHP application or runtime was found in this scope, so the PHP vulnerabilities CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619 have no identified entry point here. The PHP project also reported CVE-2026-115560 on October 23 for an unusual combination of session settings and application behavior; the same absence of PHP applies here. This does not assess unrelated infrastructure. Official PHP security notice.

Plervo Suite and its available applications are experimental alpha software. The catalogue shows which apps are qualified for each platform.

PDF redaction security update

Earlier PDF versions could retain vector content behind a visual clipping mask. PDF 0.1.0-alpha.7 refuses unsupported partial vector paths, clipping paths and shading redactions and leaves every page unchanged if the operation fails. Updating the app does not sanitize existing PDFs: review previously redacted documents before sharing them again. The new packages also include additional third-party copyright and license notices.

Corrected packages, availability and verification details.

Checks before installation

The Suite accepts packages only from the official Plervo release repository. Downloads are checked against their SHA-256, product identity and release version. On Mac, it also verifies the bundle identifier, Maintech developer signature and Gatekeeper assessment. On Linux, it rejects archive links and unsafe paths, limits extracted size, checks executables and installs the complete package in your user account. The previous installation is preserved until its replacement is ready. Downgrades are refused.

On Mac, uninstall moves only the selected app to Trash; if that fails, it stays installed. On Linux, it removes only that app’s managed package. Removal is refused while the app is running. Documents and preferences are kept.

What we test

Automated checks cover release selection, downloads, interrupted transfers, cancellation, rollback, signatures, versions and language selection. Final Mac packages undergo Apple notarization and malware scanning. Representative app tests check format round trips, exports, rendering, spreadsheet values and invalid inputs with independent file readers. Native Linux CI exercises installation, reinstallation, removal and GUI startup in clean distribution containers.

Internal Windows candidates have passed native installation, repair/removal, representative CLI operations and GUI startup/normal-close checks. They are not public signed releases.

PDF editing, save/reopen, forms, encryption and redaction are tested with synthetic documents. An earlier PDF baseline completed 188,495 fuzz runs in 15 minutes with no observed crash or hang. That result does not certify every application or later build.

Official packages

The Mac publisher is Maintech Solutions LLC. Get installers, source provenance and SHA-256 checksums from the official alpha release. Install Plervo Suite first, then choose an available app.

Known limits

Keep backups of important documents. Clean-machine Mac coverage, every GUI workflow, audio device, third-party plugin and graphics driver have not been qualified. Plervo PDF is available in Microsoft Store for Windows 10/11 x64. Security update 1.0.7.0 has passed Microsoft certification. Store rollout controls when the update reaches each device; confirm version 1.0.7.0 or newer is installed before using redaction. Other Windows apps remain in preparation. Linux tests use Ubuntu 24.04, Debian 13 and Fedora 44; the Suite also has Ubuntu 26.04 coverage. They use an X11 virtual display. Native Wayland sessions, other distributions and Linux ARM64 remain untested.

The Suite follows the operating-system language by default and offers English, Portuguese and Spanish. Translation coverage differs across apps; Slides and Audio are English-only at this alpha stage. PDF OCR targets English, and some Chinese and Telugu interface characters may need system font fallback.

No audit or malware scan guarantees the absence of vulnerabilities. Read the release notes for the exact packages and tested scope.

Report a vulnerability

Use the private security channel on GitHub and choose “Report a vulnerability”. Include the version, operating system and steps using a test document. Never post passwords or personal documents in public issues.
PRIVACY_DESCRIPTION: Privacy on the Plervo website, in the Suite and in its applications.
PRIVACY_HTML:
This website

This site has no advertising cookies, analytics, forms or PDF uploads. Cloudflare, our hosting provider, may process technical connection details such as IP addresses to deliver and protect the pages.

Language and download suggestions

English is the default. Language links open the equivalent page in Portuguese or Spanish; your choice stays in the URL as you browse. We do not store it in cookies or local storage.

Operating-system suggestions use information already exposed by your browser, on your device. This information is not stored or transmitted. The suggestion does not identify your processor; check compatibility before downloading.

The app

PDF editing and bundled OCR run on your computer. In the standalone edition, “Check for updates” contacts GitHub for release information. The Microsoft Store edition opens the Store update flow instead. Neither update check uploads your PDF. Opening external document links or the support page uses your browser and the destination service. Local automation is disabled by default: the UI control channel must be explicitly enabled, is restricted to loopback and requires a session token. The separate command-line MCP interface also requires an explicit launch.

External services

Downloads are hosted on GitHub. The voluntary support link opens AlporT’s page, the creator of Plervo, on Buy Me a Coffee. Their privacy policies apply when you visit them.

Updated on October 27, 2026.

Plervo Suite

The standalone edition checks GitHub at startup and every six hours while it is open, unless you select Manual in Settings. Checks send ordinary connection metadata, including your IP address and the app user agent; they do not send documents, filenames or your installed-app list. Installing an app downloads its package from the official Plervo repository. Suite does not require a GitHub account or install a background service. If you explicitly configure an optional GitHub API token, Suite sends it to GitHub for authenticated requests. Update notices and donation links open your browser only when you choose them.

Microsoft Store edition

The Store edition reads the current user’s installed Plervo Store-package names and versions locally to display and open those apps. Its settings stay on the device. It does not send this inventory to Plervo, query GitHub or download installers itself. When you choose to acquire an app or check for updates, it opens Microsoft Store, whose account, download and privacy rules apply. Suite does not open or upload your documents, collect analytics or install a background service. Optional support opens Buy Me a Coffee in your browser.

Plervo Video and Plervo CAD — Microsoft Store editions

These editions process the media, projects and drawings you open on your computer. They do not require a Plervo account or automatically upload your files to Plervo. Projects, exports, recent-file lists and preferences are saved locally. Windows backup, cloud-synced folders or other software you choose may copy those files separately.

Microsoft Store handles installation and updates under Microsoft’s privacy terms. Help, source-code and optional support links open external websites in your browser; those sites receive ordinary connection information and apply their own privacy policies. The support link opens Buy Me a Coffee, unlocks no features and does not collect payment details inside the app. Microsoft is not the fundraiser or payment provider.

The packaged desktop apps omit the optional local-control server. Command-line automation and MCP require an explicit launch. The Video Store package also omits optional downloadable speech-model features. These statements describe the Store editions being prepared for submission; they do not imply certification or current availability.

Other applications

Individual apps may offer network features such as sharing or integrations. When you choose those features, the destination service’s data handling applies. The Suite’s installer does not proxy or upload documents.
ABOUT_TITLE: Our own identity. An open foundation.
ABOUT_DESCRIPTION: The Plervo Suite, its open-source foundations and credits.
ABOUT_HTML:
Plervo is an independent project by AlporT. Start with Plervo Suite, then choose the available applications from its catalogue.

The Suite combines an original Plervo interface with installation components adapted from ArtCraft Launcher 0.4.1. Plervo PDF is based on PdfCraft 0.8.0. The other applications use separately pinned open-source foundations, documented in the source catalogue. Authors’ credits and MIT/Apache-2.0 notices are preserved. Fonts, icons and libraries retain their own licences.

One Suite, a growing collection

The catalogue covers documents, images, illustration, video, motion graphics, publishing, presentations, spreadsheets, technical drawing, audio and interface design. Each application card shows its actual availability by platform. Packages appear only after their applicable validation and signing checks. Plervo PDF is available in Microsoft Store; Plervo Suite for Windows is also available and currently offers PDF. Other Windows apps remain in preparation.

The Suite manages installation and updates for available apps. Suite also notifies you when a newer installer is available and opens its official download when you choose to update. These are experimental alpha releases: see the release notes and limitations and source code.

Plervo is not affiliated with Adobe or the ArtCraft team. Adobe and Acrobat are trademarks of their respective owners.
